 Final Injury Report for Suns-Thunder: Will Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren Play?
 Nathaniel Holloway 2026년 10월 26일 월 오후 8:00 UTC 0 The Oklahoma City Thunder are at home Monday night as they host the Phoenix Suns in a Western Conference matchup.
 Oklahoma City enters Monday’s game with a 3-0 record after defeating the Los Angeles Clippers at home Sunday night.
 Oklahoma City Thunder guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (2)Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images In Sunday’s victory, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led the way for the Thunder as he recorded 34 points, six rebounds and five assists while Ajay Mitchell added 18 points, six rebounds and four assists of his own off the bench.
 The Thunder will try to grab another victory Monday as they face off against the Suns in a tough home matchup.
 Phoenix enters Monday’s contest with a 1-1 record after defeating the Golden State Warriors at home Saturday night.
 Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (15)Anna Carrington-Imagn Images Devin Booker led the way for the Suns in Saturday’s victory as he ended the game with 43 points, seven rebounds and seven assists while Miles Bridges recorded 16 points, seven rebounds and three assists.
 While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Monday night’s matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Suns Injury Report: Will Oso Ighodaro Play?
 Phoenix Suns forward Oso Ighodaro (11)Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images The Suns have two players listed on their injury report, including center Oso Ighodaro.
 Phoenix has listed Ighodaro as doubtful due to a right oblique strain and he is expected to miss his second straight game.
 With Ighodaro likely to be sidelined once again, Khaman Maluach and Duop Reath could both be in line for increased roles.
 Advertisement
 The Suns have ruled out Mark Williams as he remains sidelined while recovering from left shoulder surgery.
 Thunder Injury Report: Will Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren Play?
 Oklahoma City Thunder forward Jalen Williams (8)Kyle Terada-Imagn Images The Thunder have five players listed on their injury report, including Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren.
 Oklahoma City has ruled out Williams due to a significant lower left leg injury that he suffered in Sunday’s victory that resulted in him exiting the game on a stretcher.
 With Williams sidelined, Mitchell, Jared McCain and Alex Caruso could all be in line for increased roles moving forward.
 The Thunder have also ruled out Holmgren due to right patellar tendinitis as he will miss his first game of the season.
 Oklahoma City Thunder center Chet Holmgren (7) Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images With Holmgren sidelined, Jaylin Williams and Kenrich Williams could both have larger roles.
 Cason Wallace has also been ruled out due to left shoulder soreness that caused him to exit Sunday’s victory early.
 Thomas Sorber has also been ruled out as he continues to recover from knee surgery while Nikola Topic remains sidelined while recovering from back surgery.
 Fans can catch Monday night’s matchup between the Suns and Thunder from the Paycom Center at 8 p.m. ET.
